requirements.general_text: Any one of these: STPM – with a min. of Grade C (GPA 2.00) in any 2 subjects and a credit in English at SPM level Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least 5Bs Diploma – with a min. CGPA of 2.00 and a credit in English at SPM level Diploma – in Media and Communication or its equivalent Matriculation/Foundation – with a min. CGPA of 2.00 and credit in English at SPM level English Proficiency Requirements (International Students): TOEFL score of 500 or IELTS score of 5.0
